description: Launch a paid ad boosting a published post. THIS SPENDS MONEY from the user's prepaid ad wallet (budget + service fee). Always confirm the budget with the user before calling. Use get_boost_recommendations first for suggested settings.

budgetCents.description: Total ad budget in cents (e.g. 30000 = 300 kr). The service fee is added on top of this.

durationDays.description: How many days the ad runs

mode.description: managed: paid from the prepaid wallet incl. service fee. own_account: billed to the user's own connected ad account, no fee (requires the ads add-on)

notPoliticalConfirmed.description: Required for LinkedIn: true only after the user confirmed the ad is not political advertising (LinkedIn requires the confirmation and bans political ads)

platform.description: Platform to boost on when the post published to several; defaults to the post's own platform

targeting.description: Audience targeting; omit to let the platform decide

advantageAudience.description: Let Meta's AI expand the audience (recommended)

interests.description: Interest entities — pass through from get_boost_recommendations, do not invent ids

professional.description: LinkedIn only: the professional audience (industries, seniorities, job functions, company sizes) — pass it through unchanged from get_boost_recommendations, never invent or edit ids

name: boost_post
title: Boost Post
